findings.reason: the section's whole claim is de-duplication, and the gate would need a spy arm proving the index calls the public builder (with its own control) before it can fail on the duplication it exists to remove.
findings.text: §16 case (1) asserts "the index row and the `figure_rows` row agree on every field both carry", but those fields (`slug`, `href`, `type`, `title`, and the `width`/`height` the index already takes from the same dimension reader) already agree at base, so the behavioural arms of the new test pass on the unfixed code; the only clause that distinguishes base from head is the source inspection "defines no `_figure_row` and reads no private name", which a private duplicate under a new name satisfying, so the gate cannot show that one builder actually owns the row
